real_selling_admissible_locus.arithmetic_gate: Integral/primitively integral normalization is a separate arithmetic condition and is not implied by the real semialgebraic locus.
real_selling_admissible_locus.definition: U_Sell^R = {f in U_rho(R): det Phi(f,rho(f)) > 0 and Phi(f,rho(f)) is not positive definite}
real_selling_admissible_locus.equivalent_signature_statement: For a real symmetric nondegenerate 3x3 matrix, det>0 leaves signatures (3,0) or (1,2); excluding positive-definite gives exactly (1,2).
